dataset_policy: Public substitute for unavailable internal multimodal MC data. Original train/validation splits, image-bearing rows only, deterministic seed42 order, train2560/validation1024. Exclude cross-split duplicate normalized question+choices and duplicate image bytes; record exclusions. Never select by reward or observed decline. Pre-model raw inspection found only3633 cross-split-clean training candidates, so4096 was infeasible;2560 frozen before model outputs.
prompt_policy: Image, question, supplied hint and enumerated choices; explain reasoning then final boxed uppercase option. Never expose lecture, solution or answer in prompt. Preserve original image resolution within original processor defaults; record actual processed lengths.
pilot_policy: Independent two-step smoke per arm; formal runs restart from original weights.
checkpoint_retention: max_actor_ckpt_to_keep=2 per trainer process; retain final model/optimizer states and stage audit records. User quota precheck ~7.7TB used of10TB soft quota, so do not retain every100GB-scale checkpoint. Prior stage checkpoints may remain after process restart; inventory actual retained set at delivery.

target_runtime.note: Python patch and unspecified dependencies may differ; actual lock and smoke checks required before GPU admission. No fallback to modern image torch2.10/vllm0.17.

budget_policy: Persistent append-only allocation sessions; elapsed allocated devices count, including diagnosis gaps and failures. No reset on driver restart. Full stage estimate must fit remaining budget with20% reserve. Release resources on exit.
